files_summary.trending_datasets.json: An array of the top 20 trending datasets on Hugging Face (sorted by trendingScore). Each object contains the fields: _id, id, author, disabled, gated, lastModified, likes, trendingScore, private, sha, description, downloads, tags, createdAt, key. The dataset entries include diverse domains such as coding agent logs, code generation, reasoning, terminal interaction, source code corpora, route planning, video reasoning, document QA, travel recommendation, theorem proving, and more. This file is located at /app/database/trending_datasets.json.
files_summary.trending_models.json: An array of the top 20 trending models on Hugging Face (sorted by trendingScore). Each object includes the fields: _id, id, likes, trendingScore, private, downloads, tags, pipeline_tag, library_name, createdAt, modelId. The models span large language models (Qwen, LiquidAI, GLM, Nanbeige, MiniMax, etc.), both base and fine‑tuned variants, and GGUF quantized versions, covering image‑text‑to‑text, text generation, and multimodal tasks. This file is located at /app/database/trending_models.json.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: get_trending_datasets
tool_schemas.description: Retrieve a list of trending datasets from the local file `/app/database/trending_datasets.json`. Allows optional filtering by author or tags, sorting by a selected field, and pagination via `limit` and `offset`.

limit.description: Maximum number of dataset entries to return.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for pagination).

sort_by.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to `trendingScore`.

author.description: Filter results to datasets created by this author (exact match).

tags.description: Filter results to datasets that contain **all** of these tags.

tool_schemas.name: get_trending_models
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of trending models, optionally filtered by author (exact match), required tags (model must include all), pipeline tag, and library name, and sorted by the requested field and order. It refuses requests with invalid pagination (limit < 1 or offset < 0), an unsupported sort_by value, or an order other than "asc"/"desc". It also refuses malformed filter values such as non-string items in tags when tags is provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of model entries to return.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for pagination).

sort_by.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to `trendingScore`.

author.description: Filter results to models created by this author (exact match).

tags.description: Filter results to models that contain **all** of these tags.

pipeline_tag.description: Filter results to models with this pipeline tag (e.g., `text-generation`).

library_name.description: Filter results to models that use this library (e.g., `transformers`).

tool_schemas.name: get_dataset_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Looks up and returns the full trending dataset record whose identifier matches the provided dataset_id against either the dataset’s _id or id field. It refuses requests that omit dataset_id or provide a non-string/empty identifier. It also refuses the lookup when no dataset exists with a matching identifier.

dataset_id.description: The dataset identifier to look up (matches `_id` or `id`).

tool_schemas.name: get_model_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Looks up and returns the full trending model record whose identifier matches the provided model_id against the model’s _id, id, or modelId field. It refuses requests that omit model_id or provide a non-string/empty identifier. It also refuses the lookup when no model exists with a matching identifier.

model_id.description: The model identifier to look up (matches `_id`, `id`, or `modelId`).

metadata.name: PulseShelf Catalog Browser
metadata.description: Provides a lightweight API to browse locally stored trending dataset and model listings with lookup by ID plus basic filtering, sorting, and pagination.
